items.heading: Day 1
items.text: Day 1: Define the real work. Write what people in that skill actually do for one to three hours a day. Do not use broad labels like "digital marketing" or "analytics." Name the outputs.

items.heading: Day 2
items.text: Day 2: Watch one clean beginner breakdown. Use a short official or high-quality introduction, not ten random videos. The goal is orientation, not binge watching.

items.heading: Day 3
items.text: Day 3: Recreate one tiny task. Build one small dashboard, write one short piece of copy, redesign one screen, clean one dataset, or run one mini campaign draft.
